profile.description: o3-mini-high is OpenAI's most recent reasoning model with reasoning_effort set to high, providing frontier intelligence on most tasks. Like other models in the o-series, it is designed to excel at science, math, and coding tasks. Supports 200k tokens of input context and 100k tokens of output context.
